notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
You can congratulate me, the game is released!
It was a long way to create the game alone, but it was passed. Let the result not be what you want it to be, but you can get pleasure from the game.
I decided to make the game free, because its quality remained at a low level. The content is small, the optimization is bad, but before I released FlyingRock, I made several additions.
In the Arena mode, 12 new levels, in which new enemies appear, including 5 bosses: Devil, Banshee, Archmage, Dragon and Mill.
In the FlyingRock mode 5 new levels.
I also added a retro mode, in which the resolution changes. Perhaps someone will be more pleased to look at the pixels, rather than on a bad picture. The retro-mode has several modes.
Plus, slightly changed the economic system and balanced management and weapons.
